behaviors.find-numeronym-generator: The Numeronym generator appears in the Text tools and opens its own page.
behaviors.empty-output: On opening the generator, the empty output shows an example placeholder.
behaviors.preserve-short-words: Entering a word of three letters or fewer displays the word unchanged.
behaviors.clear-input: Clearing the word resets the output to its empty placeholder.
behaviors.copy-result: The generated numeronym can be copied with the output field’s copy button.

history.notes: The sidebar link is scoped to the tool menu, and the input locators use the components’ data-test-id attributes. The copy step checks the button’s visible “Copied!” feedback.
The output button is scoped to the numeronym field’s wrapper. Clipboard contents verify the copy action without relying on a hover tooltip that may disappear before the check runs.
